# Component Catalog

## Core case shell

- Case identity
- Lifecycle state
- Visible route
- Current stage
- Next decision
- Owner and decision owner
- Current artifact
- Timeline and audit history

## Information authoring

- Structured short answer
- Long-form rationale
- Fact input
- Assumption input
- Authored discrete judgment
- Currency and unit input
- Low / expected / high estimate
- Evidence-linked claim
- Organizational reflection

Each input must communicate whether it captures a fact, judgment, assumption, estimate, or rationale.

## Information display

- Provenance-bearing inherited value
- Superseded value comparison
- Money with currency, period, basis, and source
- Confidence and evidence strength
- State and readiness indicators
- Dense case tables
- Evidence packet
- Stakeholder and ownership rows
- Risks and blockers
- Append-only decision journal

## Analytical components

- Connected discrete scale
- Three-point range rail
- Scenario interval display
- Directly labeled bars
- Readiness matrix
- Influence / impact matrix
- Timeline
- Process flow
- Relationship map
- Compact triangle profile where useful

Avoid anonymous charts, decorative donuts, and metrics without decision meaning.

## Page compositions

- Application home
- Case portfolio
- Case overview
- Stage workspace
- Workspace with inspector
- Evidence review
- Decision review
- Final dossier
- Marketing proposition hero
- Editorial hero
- Case-proof hero
- Mobile case composition
